steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Populate the pricing sheet so a price and calculated total are present.
Verify the product selection populated the default variant.
Ensure the requested quantity is entered as 10 in the sheet.
Assert that Quantity Requested is retained as 10.
Verify that Total Amount is populated after the pricing sheet has a price.
Invite one available QA vendor to satisfy the publish prerequisite.
Confirm that publishing reached the real project page.
